notes.title: Massive update(Version3.0)
notes.content:
Bug fix
・Fixed the game sometimes freezes when selecting the language in Title> Settings

システム
・New system "Auto Setting" added

Game Play
・New operation "slow" added

・New system "gimmick" added
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36218419/8100ff2c30cb1d9b656050b4716c1b6db1447351.pngBush
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36218419/0532ea41e63457016d647aec164792219119926b.pngPortal
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36218419/a8cadef508746223e44178e0e48af891f567e72b.pngCapture Mine
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36218419/902c6180cb2e214fd563c52b32030b34c8f02c6f.pngMine Factory

・New system "Trait" added

・New game rule "Survival" added

・Remake all stages
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36218419/f87ca4b343a8e861bddde0ebf228e8bef8a4dc6e.png

・6 new stages added

Removed the same type skills cooldown sharing

・New skills added
🆕Leap
🆕Claw

・Skill deleted
ːRivalsːAdrenaline

・Skill balance

🔵Thunder
Aiming has gradually increased
Infinite aiming duration

🔵Mirage
Cooldown reduction 6 seconds → 4 seconds
Fake movement direction changed from random to always forward

🔵Masquerade
Fake duration extension 6 seconds → 12 seconds
Old fake will now disappear when using a skill

🔵Portal
Infinite duration
It became possible to specify the installation direction

🔵Turret
Infinite duration
It became possible to specify the installation direction
Shoot can now be destroyed with Ray

🔻Shift
Shoot duration reduced from 12 seconds to 3 seconds
The moving speed of the shoot decreases

🔻Mine
No longer detects enemies for 1 second after installation
Infinite duration

🔻Abyss
The timing when the hit judgment occurs is slightly delayed
Cooldown slightly extended
The attack range has become slightly smaller

🔻Spirit
Reduced movement speed when in movement mode

◇Gemini
Shoot becomes indestructible with Ray
Hit detection no longer occurs near the shoot

・Reduce game speed
Slowing down the player's basic movement speed.
